tweet_text: this could be a lot better, but i don't need a lot of images of individual buildings to get things that are decent, this is a first pass at generating something from a single angle shot of the canteen/pool area, if you've been to @vibecamp_ and have images of the buildings, please share them with me!

references.name: Vibecamp
references.evidence: Explicitly mentioned in the tweet text as the subject venue of the 3D generation.

result.one_line: A turntable rotation showing a rough 3D reconstruction of the Vibecamp canteen and pool area.
